heading level 3, Avoid adding functionality to allow selecting multiple options
The select component does not support selecting multiple options,
link, as there's a history of poor usability and assistive technology support for <select multiple>
. If you need to ask the user to pick more than one item from a list, it's almost always better to use another method, such as a list of checkboxes.
heading level 2, Research on this component
User research has shown that some users struggle with selects.
heading level 3, Known issues and gaps
Research shows that users can struggle with selects, particularly when users have:
. been unable to close the select, 1 of 5
• tried to type into the select, 2 of 5
. confused focused items with selected items, 3 of 5
• tried to pinch zoom select options on smaller devices, 4 of 5
. not understood that they can scroll down to see more items, or how to, 5 of 5
